title: Australia Sent Soldiers With Machine Guns to Fight Emus #shorts
description:
In November 1932, Australia sent soldiers to Western Australia to deal with emus that were damaging farmers' wheat crops. Major Meredith led the operation with two Lewis guns and 10,000 rounds. His report claimed 986 emus killed, but historians say that number is highly disputed. The soldiers were withdrawn after bad press, sent back, and recalled in December. A bounty system for emus continued instead. A true story, known as the Great Emu War.
